headline: Set $1,000 monthly rent and ordered repairs in the Vaccianna v Seramonte LLC case; other tenant rents were also set or kept.
summary: The commission heard the Vaccianna v Seramonte LLC case, and the landlord did not attend. It set rent at $1,000.00 per month and ordered repairs. It also set or kept rent in three other cases, and it tabled approval of the July 16, 2026 special meeting minutes.
decisions: Tabled approval of the July 16, 2026 special meeting minutes until the next hearing.
Motion passed on the landlord's request for a continuance in FRC-260723-J Vincent v Seramonte LLC.

Set rent at $1,000.00 per month until health, safety and building code ordinances are in compliance, and ordered the landlord to repair the central air conditioning and replace the microwave and other appliances.
Kept rent at $720.00 per month starting August 1, 2026, with the prior rent abatement in effect until the March 5, 2026 order is fully complied with.
Kept rent at $1.00 until all relevant health and safety regulations are in full compliance and confirmed by Quinnipiack Valley Health District.
Set rent at $700.00 until all issues flagged by Quinnipiack Valley Health District are resolved, with the commission to revisit it next month.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Fair Rent Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
6:00 PM, August 6, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
fairrent@Hamden.com 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 
 
  1. Commissioner Roll Call   
  Chair Commissioner Cunningham called the meeting to order at 6:12 P.M. 
Commissioner Vice Chair Conte Robinson present 
Commissioner Amy Molina present 
Commissioner Chanelle Goldson present 
Quorum established 
Attorney Tim Lee present 
Director Karen Bivens present 
Commissioner Jennifer Paradis absent 
Commissioner Greta Johnson absent 
Commissioner Jacob Marrandino absent 
Commissioner Antwan Nedd absent 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 
 
  1. FRC-260705-C Vaccianna V Seramonte LLC  
  
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. Fair Rent Commission Special Meeting July 16, 2026 Minutes.pdf  
  Motion tabled until next hearing. 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 Paul Boudreau from the tenants union spoke. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE   
 
 
  1. FRC-260723-J Vincent v Seramonte LLC landlord requested continuance.  
  Motion passed. 
6. CASES TO BE HEARD
1. FRC-260705-C Vaccianna V Seramonte LLC 
       
  Kaleen Vaccianna, tenant, and Rachel Vincent, witness, were sworn in by Chair 
Commissioner Cunningham and gave testimony. Seramonte LLC, landlord, was not 
present at the hearing and no continuance was requested. 
Motion: Rent shall be set at $1,000.00 per month until health, safety and building 
code ordinances are in compliance. Landlord is also further ordered to repair the 
central air conditioning, replace the microwave, and other appliances according to the 
most recently signed lease agreement. The landlord is further ordered to avoid any 
retaliatory actions as defined in the Connecticut General statutes.  Motioned by Chair 
Commissioner Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner Robinson. 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION   
 No executive session. 
8. REPORTS   
 No reports. 
9. OLD BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. FRC-260206-V Sindo v 70 Circular Ave  
  Motion: Rent shall remain at $720.00 per month, starting August 1, 2026. The 
previous rent abatement shall remain in effect until the Commission’s order issued on 
March 5, 2026, has been fully complied with, including the proper repair and 
inspection of the HVAC system, remediation of the water intrusion, and completion of 
any other major repairs identified. Motioned by Chair Commissioner Cunningham, 2nd 
Commissioner Molina. 
  2. FRC-260421-K Harris V Parmar  
  Motion: Rent shall remain at $1.00 until all relevant health and safety regulations are 
in full compliance, and we have confirmation of that from Quinnipiack Valley Health 
District (QVHD). Motioned by Chair Commissioner Cunningham, 2nd Commissioner 
Molina. 
  3. FRC-260313-H Taylor V Rodriguez  
  Motion: Rent is set at $700.00 until we have confirmation that all issues flagged by 
Quinnipiack Valley Health District (QVHD) have been resolved. The commission will 
revisit it again next month. Motioned by Chair Commissioner Cunningham, 2nd 
Commissioner Molina. 
  4. FRC-260623-X Webster V Magenic Real Estate  
  
 
10. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
11. ADJOURNMENT   
 The meeting was adjourned at 7:50 p.m.
